data.narrative:
NuScale Power is a public-stage nuclear energy company founded by José Reyes and Paul G. Lorenzini, having raised over $600M to date. The valuation universe consists of 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 5 private competitors (Oklo, Nano Nuclear Energy, X-Energy, Fuse Energy, Terrestrial Energy), yielding a total of 8 comparable companies in the nuclear energy sector.

The peer-median method is not applicable in this case. While 4 same-sector peers exist in nuclear energy, the filtering criteria—same stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than 3 datapoints in any narrow cohort, falling short of the minimum threshold required for reliable triangulation. An all-sector median approach would introduce substantial distortion given the sector's unique capital intensity and regulatory environment, rendering the method unreliable.

With the primary triangulation method inaccessible, this analysis cannot support a quantitative valuation range at this time. Key uncertainties preventing closure include the sparsity of directly comparable transactions in early-to-mid stage nuclear technology and the heterogeneity of business models and regulatory paths across the comp set. A defensible valuation would require either (1) expansion of the dataset to include adjacent energy infrastructure peers, (2) transaction-based precedent if available, or (3) explicit DCF assumptions tied to specific commercialization milestones and licensing timelines.
